# PostgreSQL Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.postgres` |
| Source | `09_docker/postgres.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, databases |

Vanilla PostgreSQL 16 instance for relational storage. Used when no vector workload
is required; the pgvector image is preferred for the content graph MVP.
